responsibility: Defines the public interface for the C-lexer token buffer used by GNU Modula-2’s C-facing scanner (`clex`). It specifies the C token enumeration, exported current-token state, source-file/open-close and pass-reset operations, token-stream rewind/insertion services, token-to-line/file mapping for included files, and a small macro-definition API used during buffered replay and substitution, plus the callback-style `AddTok*` entry points by which `cflex` deposits scanned tokens into the buffer.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of the CLexBuf pair: it publishes the token type enum, exported current-token state, and the procedures that callers and the cflex scanner use to feed, rewind, query, and manage buffered tokens. Unlike CLexBuf.mod, it does not contain the bucketed token storage, macro-expansion machinery, or include-stack/source-location implementation.
